text: People say eating organic food improves health, so this particular organic snack must cure my headaches.
Education generally improves people's lives, therefore this school will definitely produce geniuses.
Technology helps society progress, so this startup will obviously succeed.
Healthy foods contain vitamins, which means taking this vitamin supplement will cure insomnia.
Vehicles are designed for transportation, so this particular car must be reliable.
Innovation drives progress in general, which is why this project is guaranteed to succeed.
Exercise improves health, so this new fitness gadget will solve all medical problems.
Reading books improves knowledge, therefore reading this one article will make someone an expert.
Einstein became a genius because he was born in Ulm, so anyone born in Ulm must be a genius.
The startup will succeed because its founder happens to be named Rahul Sharma.
This painting must be valuable because it was painted on a Tuesday.
The team won because the captain wore these exact shoes.
The city became prosperous because the mayor was born in 1973.
This technology will change the world because only this company invented it.
The bridge still stands today because it was inaugurated on a rainy afternoon.
The athlete won the race because he wore those specific socks.
This medicine is completely safe because no one has ever tested it.
The system must be secure since nobody has audited it yet.
The building is stable because inspectors say it might collapse.
This investment is risk-free since analysts say the risks are unknown.
This research must be reliable because nobody has verified it.
The aircraft is reliable because engineers warn it might fail.
This algorithm is unbiased since its fairness has never been tested.
The medication is harmless because side effects are undocumented.
Bitcoin must be a great investment because its price rose dramatically over the last decade.
Remote work obviously improves productivity since employees no longer commute.
Nuclear energy is completely safe because modern reactors have safeguards.
Social media strengthens democracy because information spreads quickly.
Electric cars are always better because they don't produce tailpipe emissions.
Online education must be superior because students can learn from anywhere.
Cryptocurrency is stable since the blockchain technology behind it is secure.
Artificial intelligence will eliminate all jobs because automation is increasing.
The invisible unicorn must control the weather because it lives in the clouds.
The dragon living under the mountain causes earthquakes because it moves around.
A ghost engineer must have fixed the machine overnight.
The sea serpent protects ships during storms.
The moon rabbit cooks rice which explains the patterns we see on the moon.
The sky castle protects the kingdom because it floats above the clouds.
The invisible king secretly governs the city.
The fairy in the garden ensures flowers grow quickly.
The Eiffel Tower must predate industrialization because it was built in 1820.
Newton discovered electricity, which is why electrical theory follows his work.
The Pacific Ocean is the smallest ocean, so crossing it should be easy.
The Great Wall of China must be enormous because it can be seen from the moon.
Shakespeare wrote many novels, which is why modern novels follow his style.
The sun revolves around Earth, proving Earth is the center of the universe.
The Nile flows westward, so western Africa receives its water.
Mars has breathable oxygen, which means humans could live there easily.
Antibiotics cure infections, so they should cure every infection.
Exercise reduces weight, which means exercising once will guarantee weight loss.
